samples.rationale: All seven candidates appear pixel-identical — an incomplete open shell with chaotic, spiky wood-and-stone framing and no coherent roof, walls, doors, or plinth — scoring uniformly low against the concept's clean steep-gabled barn with dressed stone walls and finished facade.

All seven candidates appear identical — roofless, structurally chaotic shells with no gable, no enclosed roof form, and ragged walls — scoring uniformly low against a concept that shows a clean stone barn with a complete dark-oak gabled roof and dressed pilaster facade.

All seven candidates are visually identical — a roofless, hollow shell with chaotic stone/wood wall fragments and no pitched roof, no pilasters, no doors, and no plinth — scoring uniformly near zero against a concept that shows a complete, well-massed longhouse with a steep dark-oak gable roof and clean stone-brick facade.
